eligibility_items.E1_fields_complete: all nine PLAN 9 proposal fields present and specific (0/1)
eligibility_items.E2_literature: identifiable published basis with honest MODEL_INTERNAL_UNVERIFIED provenance, no fabricated citations (0/1)
eligibility_items.E3_arms: anchor + justified neighbour + causal control, control plausibly destroys mechanism (0/1)
eligibility_items.E4_implementable: expressible against factory as-built (universe/loader/calendar/accounting/execution) with synthetic fixtures (0/1)
eligibility_items.E5_cost_borrow: feasibility coherent with declared cost models; no free-borrow or free-fill assumption (0/1)
eligibility_items.E6_not_rescue: different observable AND counterparty AND clock AND causal control vs rejected crypto families M01/funding-carry/weekly-reversal (0/1)
eligibility_items.E7_a7_clean: A7 reports zero unresolved HIGH/CRITICAL objections (0/1)

selection_rule: eligible = rubric sum 7/7; rank by (A7 novelty_source_quality score desc, hypothesis_id lex asc); take exactly top 2; fewer than two eligible closes STOCKS_BLOCKED_SELECTION_INSUFFICIENT
orthogonality_note: PLAN_stocks sets no numeric rho threshold; A7 documents STRUCTURAL orthogonality (observable/clock/counterparty/control) among selected families; quantitative prewindow rho marked NOT_IMPLEMENTABLE_NO_REAL_DATA
